purpose: Teach: 車輪/離陸/発車/発せ/呼び出さ/乗り込み/買い求め/現況

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査車両の車輪点検もされますね
lines.en: The police maintain strict inspection protocols for patrol vehicle wheels, don't they.
lines.style: Respectful, conversational observation. Even, measured pace. Slightly appreciative lift at the end—acknowledging competence without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人が空港で離陸前に確保される事案もありますね
lines.en: The police do manage to apprehend suspects at the airport before departure sometimes, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, noting a fact with mild wonder. Slower cadence. Slight pause before the final clause, as if drawing on an example he's heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急車両の発車時刻を細かく管理されますね
lines.en: The police schedule emergency vehicle dispatch times with real precision, don't they.
lines.style: Observant, almost admiring. Steady tone. A hint of emphasis on 'precision'—recognizing the logistical care involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、危険時に警報を発せられる体制を備えてらっしゃいますね
lines.en: The police have put systems in place to issue alarms when danger strikes, haven't they.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Calm, grounded delivery. Emphasizes the readiness—not panicked, just solid.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人を呼び出される際の手続きを丁寧にされますね
lines.en: The police handle witness summons with real care and procedure, don't they.
lines.style: Warm recognition of thoughtfulness. Gentle emphasis on 'care.' Slower, deliberate—he's noticing the consideration involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場へ素早く乗り込みされますね
lines.en: The police do move quickly when they arrive at the scene, don't they.
lines.style: Light admiration. Quick tempo on 'quickly'—mirroring the action he's describing. Acknowledging efficiency with respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査用具を必要に応じて買い求められますね
lines.en: The police procure investigation equipment as the situation demands, don't they.
lines.style: Practical observation. Even, measured pace. A note of respect for resourcefulness—matter-of-fact but appreciative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、事件の現況を上層部に随時報告されますね
lines.en: The police keep their superiors updated on case developments as they unfold, don't they.
lines.style: Closer now, slightly more personal. Warm recognition. Steady but with a subtle undertone of connection—understanding the chain of command and its weight.
